description: AGSC-09-17 (a): `export --okf --manifest` writes the export of `export-0001` and, beside its files, `export-manifest.json`. Same fixture as `export-0001`: the minimal Bundle with `LICENSE-CONTENT` and the concepts `edited`, `undated` and the draft `draft-note`. `files` is the whole list of files written, now with the manifest, in code-point order of the path. The manifest is one JCS object with one trailing LF and exactly the members `bundle_hash`, `bundle_version`, `files`, `item_count`, `items_digest` and `spec_version`. `bundle_hash` is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the `graph.nq` of the same build (the value `agsc-bundle-hash` carries, AGSC-06-08); `bundle_version` is `0.0.0+20260101T000000Z`, the content version of a Bundle with no git history built at SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1767225600 (as `export-0001` shows); `files` has one `{content_digest, path}` for each file except the manifest, in code-point order of `path`, `content_digest` being the value `sha-256=:<base64>:` of RFC 9530 over the bytes of that file, standard base64 with padding; `item_count` is 5 (the draft is not published, AGSC-06-30); `items_digest` is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of the array of the five item IRIs in code-point order. The value of `spec_version` is the tool's own and is not pinned. The manifest does not list itself.
